references.text: Isaiah also uses the expression 'Woe!' (אוֹי) as a cry of lament over judgment and destruction, similar to Balaam's prophetic lament.
Jeremiah asks rhetorically who can survive the Lord's judgment, a theme that reflects Balaam's question about who can live when God acts.
Joel describes the day of the Lord as terrible and asks who can endure it, similar to Balaam's question about survival.
Earlier in the same prophecy, Balaam speaks of a future ruler from Israel, which provides context for this final cry of lament.
The Revelation of John poses the same existential question: 'Who can stand?' when God's wrath comes.
